caseName: United States v. Standard Oil Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. The Standard Oil Company, a Corporation Organized and Existing Under the Laws of the State of Indiana

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied. The Attorney General, The Solicitor General, Mr. Frank B. Kellogg, Mr. E. W. Sims and Mr. James H. Wilkerson for petitioner. Mr. John S. Miller, Mr. Moritz Rosenthal and Mr. Alfred D. Eddy for respondent.
